metadata.description: Curated protected gene list for H1 human embryonic stem cells. Genes listed here are force-included in SPORE HVG selection regardless of variance threshold. Tier 1 genes are rescued first when space is limited; Tier 3 last.

tier_definitions.1: Core master regulators. Their absence fundamentally distorts pluripotency GRN topology. Always rescue these first.
tier_definitions.2: Critical pathway nodes and chromatin regulators. High-priority rescue — absence loses major biological axes.
tier_definitions.3: Extended regulatory context. Rescue when HVG budget allows. Absence acceptable at very low HVG counts.

metadata.selection_criterion: A gene is protected if: (a) it is a known TF or direct chromatin co-regulator in this cell type, AND (b) it is plausibly constitutively expressed (low variance, likely to be dropped by seurat_v3 HVG selection), OR (c) it is a master regulator whose regulatory output spans many downstream targets.
metadata.notes: Gene symbols are HGNC standard. For datasets using Ensembl IDs, translate this list before loading. The 'user_defined' category is empty by default — add any study-specific genes there.

core_pluripotency.rationale: The OCT4/SOX2/NANOG triad defines pluripotency identity. POU5F1 is typically constitutively expressed at stable low-to-moderate levels in hESCs and is frequently filtered by variance-based HVG selection.

extended_pluripotency.rationale: Secondary pluripotency factors and naive-state markers. Many are expressed at stable basal levels and thus low-variance. LIN28A and LIN28B regulate let-7 miRNAs and are important RNA-binding pluripotency factors.

prc1_prc2_complex.rationale: Polycomb repressive complexes maintain bivalent chromatin at developmental gene promoters in hESCs. EZH2 and SUZ12 (PRC2) are often constitutively expressed at stable levels that fall below HVG thresholds.

nurd_complex.rationale: NuRD complex (nucleosome remodeling and deacetylase) is highly active in hESCs for gene silencing and chromatin compaction. Members are stably expressed and frequently filtered from HVG sets.

dna_methylation.rationale: DNA methylation writers and erasers. TET enzymes and DNMTs are stably expressed in hESCs and regulate pluripotency gene promoters. Their constitutive expression makes them low-variance targets.

histone_methylation.rationale: H3K4, H3K27, H3K36, and H3K9 methyltransferases/demethylases that shape the hESC epigenetic landscape. KDM1A (LSD1) is a particularly critical pluripotency regulator.

hat_super_enhancer.rationale: HAT complexes and BET bromodomain proteins regulate super-enhancers at OCT4, NANOG, and SOX2 loci. BRD4 and MED1 are architectural components of pluripotency super-enhancers and often constitutively expressed.

swi_snf_baf.rationale: SWI/SNF (BAF) chromatin remodeling complexes are essential for maintaining open chromatin at pluripotency loci. SMARCA4 (BRG1) and CHD7 are critical for OCT4/SOX2 target accessibility.

tgf_beta_nodal.rationale: TGF-β/NODAL/Activin signaling is the primary self-renewal pathway in primed hESCs. SMAD2/3/4 are the transducing TFs. SMAD2 and SMAD4 are frequently stable and low-variance.

lif_jak_stat.rationale: LIF/JAK/STAT3 pathway — primary self-renewal signal in naive PSCs and a secondary signal in primed hESCs. STAT3 is constitutively expressed but often below HVG variance threshold.

hippo_yap.rationale: YAP1 and TEAD4 mediate mechanotransduction and growth signals in hESCs. YAP1 nuclear localization supports OCT4 expression; its transcriptional activity is low-variance at baseline.

wnt_signaling.rationale: WNT/β-catenin signaling influences pluripotency exit and naive-primed transitions. CTNNB1 (β-catenin) is ubiquitously expressed and likely filtered from HVG sets.

chromatin_architecture.rationale: CTCF and cohesin organize TADs and enhancer-promoter loops at pluripotency loci. These architectural proteins are constitutively expressed and almost always filtered by variance-based HVG selection.

cell_cycle_pluripotency.rationale: hESCs have an unusual cell cycle with a compressed G1. E2F1/CDK4/CDK6/CCND1 regulate the G1 checkpoint in a way tightly linked to pluripotency maintenance. Often low-variance in cycling hESCs.

user_defined.rationale: Study-specific genes added manually. This category is intended for genes not covered by the curated categories above but relevant to the specific experimental question.
